verdict.rationale: Customer email subscriptions to changelog entries are a fair axis for a product-management platform, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions a changelog, a customer-facing update feed, or email subscriptions. The Webhooks API only lets developers receive entity-change events at their own endpoint. That is a building block for constructing such a feature, not the feature itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can let customers subscribe to email updates when new changelog entries are published
